title: Paloma and the Crown
author: Hazel Pemberton
blurb: Lena Vasquez, a royal food-taster building immunity one dish at a time, has spent five years selling small charms in a city that outlawed magic. Then the old gods begin answering prayers again — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must unbind a king from the thing wearing his crown before the usurper's armies reach the free cities.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
